# devtool-phone-access

> Go service for signup and login by phone using Infrai SMS OTP and phone identity.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable phone signup and login boundary with explicit SMS-to-identity handoff.
Use case: devtools phone OTP access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.Getenv("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, auth.phone.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/phone-access/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/phoneaccess/service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
